implementationScope: package-only backend-neutral progressive packed RGB8 finalization below the DecodedImage/CoreGraphics boundary
requiredInvariants: The capability is discoverable from any ImageProgressiveDecodeSession value without downcasting to the JPEG kernel type.
The finalization sourceByteCount equals the complete validated encoded body and is produced only from finalReady.
The transferred value is tight uint8 RGB with no synthesized alpha, bytesPerRow == width*3, colorEncoding sRGB and sourceColorProfile absent.
For profile-absent JFIF, output sRGB fallback is distinct from source-profile classification; the source is not mislabeled standardSRGB.
The packed value byte/hash equals the independent kernel RGB and its transfer charge equals the pre-finish codecOwnedRGB8 ledger transfer bound.
Wrapping the kernel Data in ImagePackedRGB8 reuses the same pixel backing; this seam does not create a second RGB payload or traverse CoreGraphics.
maximumTightRGBABytes remains zero because this capability qualifies RGB8, not an alpha-expanded RGBA transfer.
After packed finalization the session is terminal and its resource ledger is fully reclaimed.
